findings.issue: User theme preference (light/dark manual toggle) has no CSS selector - .dark class never matched
findings.impact: Theme toggle cycles modes but has zero visual effect. All theme CSS is inside @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) only. Phase 1 (design system foundations) is incomplete.
findings.fix: Add .dark and :root:not(.light) selectors alongside the media query

findings.issue: No member list, invite, or member management UI exists in the frontend
findings.impact: Phase 3 (channel/chat surfaces) and Phase 4 (search/profile/settings) are incomplete. Users cannot discover workspace members or manage access.
findings.fix: Create /members route page with member list, role display, role management, and invite flow

findings.issue: No profile editing for display name, status, or bio - only avatar upload available
findings.impact: Phase 4 (profile surfaces) is incomplete. Display name is auto-derived from email, cannot be changed. User identity is permanently tied to email prefix.
findings.fix: Create profile settings page with editable display name, status message, and bio fields

findings.issue: No route-group-specific not-found.tsx pages for (workspace) or (auth) route groups
findings.impact: Invalid workspace slugs or channel IDs show simple inline text ('Channel not found') instead of proper 404 UX with navigation options. Only root not-found.tsx exists.
findings.fix: Add not-found.tsx to (workspace) and (auth) route groups with relevant navigation links

findings.issue: Settings page only has appearance and notification preferences - no account, profile, workspace, or channel settings
findings.impact: Phase 4 (settings surfaces) is incomplete. Users cannot change password, manage workspaces, configure channel defaults, or manage billing.
findings.fix: Expand settings with account section (profile, password), workspace section (name, slug, avatar), and channel defaults

findings.issue: Ctrl+1-9 workspace switching listed in keyboard shortcut help but not implemented in the handler
findings.impact: Misleading help dialog shows shortcuts that do nothing. Phase 5 (interaction polish) incomplete.
findings.fix: Either implement workspace switching shortcuts or remove them from the help dialog

findings.issue: Keyboard shortcuts not discoverable - no '?' hint or shortcut icon visible in any UI element
findings.impact: Users may never discover the keyboard shortcut dialog exists. Phase 5 (interaction polish) could improve here.
findings.fix: Add a small '?' button or keyboard icon to the app header or sidebar footer that opens the shortcuts dialog
